build.buildCommand: COMPOSER_ALLOW_SUPERUSER=1 composer update --no-dev --no-interaction --optimize-autoloader --no-scripts && npm install && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: rm -f backend/bootstrap/cache/*.php && php artisan config:clear && php artisan package:discover --ansi && php artisan migrate:fresh --seed --force; php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=$PORT
